captions.detailed: A classic architect's desk lamp made of matte black and silver metallic materials. It features a heavy, flat cylindrical base supporting a pivoting lower joint, which connects to a dual-bar lower arm. A middle joint links this to a dual-bar upper arm, with both arm segments tensioned by silver helical springs. The upper arm terminates in an adjustable joint holding a conical lamp shade with a small rear switch.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of an adjustable architect's desk lamp. The lamp should feature a heavy circular base, two articulating arm segments tensioned by silver helical coils, and a pivoting conical lamp head, all constructed with realistic joints for realistic mechanical movement.
captions.factory: The model is built using an ArticulatedObject structure. The base is constructed from a flat cylinder. Each joint housing is modeled using boxes and cylinders booleaned together. The parallel arm segments are constructed with thin cylinders, and the tension springs are generated by sweeping a circular profile along a helical wire path. The conical lamp head is created by lofting or revolving a tapered shell, complete with a small cylindrical toggle switch on the back.
